newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian rates steady as kuna demand slackens.
newsitem.headline: Croatian rates steady as kuna demand slackens.

text.p: Rates were steady at 10 to 13 percent on Croatian money market in Friday morning's trade, as demand for kuna funds slackened further.
Fresh loans were put at 15 million kuna, of which 11 million were call money borrowings.
"One bank is currently offering another 10 million kuna, but cannot find a borrower," a dealer told Reuters.
Thursday's overnight trade totalled 21.3 million kuna, of which only 2.3 were shortfalls at two banks. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-455705
